item.tib: sbyin bsregs me dpung dgu sgril gnod byed bsregs pa'i las mtha'
item.coloph: sbyin sregs (sreg) me dpung dgu sgril 'di/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs kyi bcud/ las ldan bu la cig gcig) rgyud mdzod/ sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ gnas mchog phug leb stag rtse ru/ mkha' 'gro kye ma 'od mtsho yi (yis/)rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal des zhal slobs (slob) bde chen mi 'gyur la brgyud//
